description_en: Retrieves data for delivery monitoring metrics
kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail describe-trail-delivery-metric-data --metric-name delivery_sls_success_count --trail-name trail-name --start-time 2026-04-09T01:00:00Z --end-time 2026-04-10T01:00:00Z --period 3600 --api-version 2020-07-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrailDeliveryMetricData

parameters.help_en:
The name of the delivery monitoring metric. Valid values:

`delivery_sls_success_count`: The number of logs successfully delivered to SLS.

`delivery_sls_fail_count`: The number of logs that failed to be delivered to SLS.

`delivery_oss_success_count`: The number of logs successfully delivered to OSS.

`delivery_oss_fail_count`: The number of logs that failed to be delivered to OSS
parameters.help_zh:
监控指标名称：
delivery_sls_success_count：投递SLS成功日志数量
delivery_sls_fail_count：投递SLS失败日志数量
delivery_oss_success_count：投递OSS成功日志数量
delivery_oss_fail_count：投递OSS失败日志数量
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The start of the time window for the query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format: 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ'. The 'Z' indicates UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time window for the query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format: 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ'. The 'Z' indicates UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The statistical period for the metric data, in seconds. The value must be 60 or a multiple of 60.

Recommended values: 60, 900, and 3600
parameters.help_zh:
监控数据的统计周期。最小值60，支持60的倍数。

推荐取值：60、900 和 3600。单位：秒
parameters.name: period

schema.description_en: The data returned by the call

MetricList.description_en: A list of data points for the delivery monitoring metric

items.description_en: A data point for the delivery monitoring metric

Count.description_en:
The value of the metric. The meaning of this parameter depends on the value of the `MetricName` parameter in the request.

For example, if `MetricName` is set to `delivery_sls_success_count`, `Count` indicates the number of logs successfully delivered to SLS
Count.description_zh:
监控指标数量。具体含义由入参MetricName决定。

例如：MetricName入参为`delivery_sls_success_count`时，返回中的`Count`代表投递SLS成功日志数量

Timestamp.description_en: The Unix timestamp, in milliseconds, that marks the start of the time window for this data point

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
